name: grace
description: grace. — an offline-first Pomodoro timer and focus blocker (fork of Pomotroid)

scripts.check: npm run paraglide:compile && svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json
scripts.check:watch: npm run paraglide:compile && svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json --watch
scripts.test:extensions: node --test extensions/tests/appearance.test.mjs extensions/tests/policy.test.mjs extensions/tests/policies.test.mjs extensions/tests/bridge-auth.test.mjs extensions/tests/background-auth.test.mjs extensions/tests/consent.test.mjs extensions/tests/native_pairing.test.mjs extensions/tests/chrome-package.test.mjs extensions/tests/unsigned-gecko-package.test.mjs extensions/tests/signed-gecko-package.test.mjs extensions/tests/sign-firefox.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:extensions && npm run test:motion && npm run test:stats-layout && npm run test:browser-setup
